The derivation logic for memo metadata is now clear.

`internal/markdown/markdown.go` contains the primary extraction logic via `ExtractAll()`, which walks the goldmark AST. `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` orchestrates persistence through `RebuildMemoPayload()`, setting `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. Recomputation is triggered during `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`.

`UpdateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` triggers recomputation only when `content` is in the update mask. The batch runner `memopayload/runner.go:RunOnce()` rebuilds all memos in batches, but it may not be invoked from `server.go`; verification is still needed.

Stored metadata lives in MemoPayload and is recomputed on create and update. It includes tags, has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, and title. The extraction logic is in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` and orchestrated by `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`. Triggers are CreateMemo and UpdateMemo when content changes. A batch rebuild exists but is not wired to server startup. Read-time metadata is computed separately.

Read-time snippet generation happens at conversion time via `getMemoContentSnippet` or `GenerateSnippet`. It is not stored or rebuilt by `RebuildMemoPayload`. Location is user-set and not derived from content.

Computation site: `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`, a goldmark AST walk) and `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`RebuildMemoPayload`).

Triggers: `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (before persist); `UpdateMemo` in the same file, but only when the update mask includes `"content"`.

Extracted properties: derived metadata for lists and previews.

Extracted properties include `MemoPayload.tags` (markdown `#tags`), `MemoPayload.property` flags (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`), and `title` (first H1 heading). `RebuildMemoPayload` stores Tags and Property but omits Mentions. The preview snippet is generated at read time via `GenerateSnippet` in `memo_service_converter.go` and `memo_service_webhooks.go`; it is not part of `RebuildMemoPayload`.

h14.

**Computation site:** Derived memo metadata is built in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`RebuildMemoPayload`), which calls `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`) to walk the goldmark AST in one pass and write results into `store.Memo.Payload` (`proto/store/memo.proto`).

**Triggers:** Recomputation runs on `CreateMemo` (always, before persist) and on `UpdateMemo` only when the update mask includes `"content"` — both in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` can batch-rebuild all memos, but it is not wired into server startup in this repo.

**Extracted properties:** `MemoPayload.tags` (`#tag` tokens, excluding tags inside links/images) and `MemoPayload.property` (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` from the first block-level H1). These are exposed as output-only API fields in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`tags`, `property`).

**Note:** `snippet` (plain-text preview, max 64 chars via `GenerateSnippet` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`) is also content-derived for lists/previews, but it is computed at read/convert time in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`, not stored in `MemoPayload` or rebuilt by `RebuildMemoPayload`.
